title: Failure Response
shortDefinition: Failure response is the plan for the moment the first technique is blocked.
whyItMatters: The failure moment is where many people freeze, overcommit, or expose neck, back, or legs.
deepExplanation: A good system defines: if inside position is lost, reset; if they turn away, take back; if they frame, change angle. Failure is not stopping; it is branching.
beginnerView: Know what to do when the move does not work.
advancedView: Design techniques so the first failure opens the second option.
